items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: FRED MURPHY I THINK WAS THE ONE THAT WAS THE GOOD MUSICIAN, THEY WORKED DAY JOBS, THEY WOULDN'T GO OUT OF TOWN.

ctx.x: ----------TIME AGO, IT WAS JUST UNUSUAL, BECAUSE REALLY YOU GUYS WERE THE ONLY ONES EVER TO DO THAT, BECAUSE NONE OF
